concept: Desert chapel picnic with singer and goats
creativeDirection: Use daylight location photography to stage a crisp, plausible desert roadside chapel scene where the strongest sleeve motifs become real objects and the portrait figures remain recognisable within the setting.
scene: A wide 16:9 editorial photograph at a slight low eye level in an open desert roadside setting, centered on a small weathered white chapel with its doors open to reveal a glowing cross inside, and a long picnic table set out in front on dusty ground.

elements.element: the one person from reference image 1 stands near the front of the table, holding a microphone and keeping the same singing pose, shoulder-length wavy hair, and pale floral-patterned tailored jacket, lit by warm sun with a subtle pink-purple glow only in nearby fabric and objects
a folded vintage cassette J-card from reference image 2 lies on the picnic table as a real worn paper object, with visible creases, typed lines, and the upside-down lower flap

the chapel architecture and glowing cross come from reference image 3, with the three adult men from reference image 3 seated just inside and near the doorway on simple chairs with guitars, amps, cymbal stand, cables, and a central mic stand arranged naturally

the abstract orange-pink paint explosion from reference image 4 appears as a real burst of paint across a black picnic blanket and a nearby signboard, with blue edging and speckled droplets translated into physical splashes

the five young men from reference image 5 stand together beside the table and chapel fence interacting with several goats, including one large white goat clearly in the foreground and brown and black goats around them

the eagle seal from reference image 6 appears as a bold black-and-white circular emblem painted on the chapel door and repeated once on a metal cooler, with the eagle, stars, branch, bat, arrows, and shield intact

a suited hand and sleeve from reference image 7 enters from one side of the frame holding up a silver serving tray above the table, carrying a small globe, sunflowers and daisies, a white dove, a butterfly, and a small golden sun face as tangible objects
the large black star from reference image 8 is mounted high on the chapel exterior facade, with five smaller black star shapes aligned along the fence rail below

mood: surprising, open, sunlit, slightly surreal but grounded

coverSummaries.description: A close-up stage photograph of one person centered against a dark concert background with pink and purple lighting haze. The person has shoulder-length wavy hair and holds a microphone in one hand, wearing a pale tailored jacket covered in a floral or vine pattern. The composition is vertically framed with the figure filling most of the image.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a singer holding a microphone under pink-purple stage light
coverSummaries.people: one adult person standing and singing into a microphone

coverSummaries.album: Give Out But Dont Give Up The Original Memphis Recordings
coverSummaries.description: A worn, off-white cassette J-card or tape insert shown flat, with creases, slight stains, and darkened edges. The layout is mostly blank paper with typed lines arranged in a list, plus small boxes and printed bands at the top and bottom. One lower flap is upside down, emphasizing the folded paper object itself.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a folded vintage cassette tape insert card

coverSummaries.album: So Here We Are Best Of Doves
coverSummaries.description: A wide interior photograph of a church or chapel with tall stone columns, arches, wooden paneling, and a large glowing cross mounted high on a pale back wall. Three men sit spaced apart on chairs with guitars, surrounded by music equipment including amplifiers, cymbals, stands, cables, and a microphone stand in the center. The image has a soft, slightly blurred, greenish cast.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a glowing cross above three seated musicians in a church interior
coverSummaries.people: three adult men seated with guitars in a church-like hall

coverSummaries.description: An abstract cover filled with splattered paint and layered colour fields on a black background. A large irregular orange and pink burst dominates the center, with blue curved edging on the left and many speckles and droplets scattered across the image. Large repeated letterforms overlay the artwork, but the main visible scene is a vivid paint-splash composition.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a central orange-pink paint explosion on black

coverSummaries.description: A vintage outdoor group photograph showing five young men standing closely together in an animal enclosure or petting-zoo setting. Several goats crowd around them, including a large white goat in the foreground and brown and black goats at the sides. Trees, fencing, and a rustic structure appear in the background, with the men reaching toward or feeding the animals.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: five men surrounded by goats, including a large white goat in front
coverSummaries.people: five young men standing among goats

coverSummaries.description: A stark black-and-white circular emblem on a black background, resembling a seal or badge. Around the ring are many small stars, and at the center is an eagle with spread wings holding a branch in one claw and a baseball bat in the other. Above the eagle are upward-pointing arrows and ribbon shapes, with a shield on the bird’s chest.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a spread-wing eagle inside a circular seal holding a branch and a baseball bat

coverSummaries.description: A surreal collage set against a star-filled outer-space background. A hand in a dark suit sleeve holds up a silver serving tray. On the tray sit the Earth, bright flowers including sunflowers and daisies, a white dove in flight, a butterfly, and a small golden sun face at the edge. The composition centers the tray and globe against the black sky.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a hand presenting a tray topped with the Earth, flowers, and a white dove

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist white cover featuring a large solid black five-pointed star centered in the upper area. Beneath it is a row of five smaller black star shapes or star fragments spaced across the lower portion. The composition is extremely sparse and geometric.

prompt: A wide 16:9 editorial location photograph at slight low eye level in an open desert roadside setting, centered on a small weathered white chapel with open doors and a long picnic table on dusty ground in front; the one person from reference image 1 is the primary subject, standing near the front of the table holding a microphone in the same singing pose with the same shoulder-length wavy hair, expression, gaze, and pale tailored jacket covered in a floral or vine pattern; inside and around the chapel doorway, the three adult men from reference image 3 sit spaced apart on chairs with guitars, with amplifiers, a cymbal stand, cables, and a central microphone stand beneath a glowing cross mounted high on the back wall; the five young men from reference image 5 stand closely together near a rustic fence beside the chapel with several goats around them, including a large white goat prominently in the foreground and brown and black goats at the sides; a folded vintage cassette tape insert card from reference image 2 rests on the table as a real worn paper object with creases, typed lines, darkened edges, and an upside-down lower flap; the abstract orange-pink burst from reference image 4 becomes real paint splashed across a black picnic blanket and a nearby signboard with blue edging and scattered droplets; the circular eagle seal from reference image 6 is painted on the chapel door and once on a metal cooler; a dark-sleeved hand from reference image 7 enters from the side holding up a silver serving tray carrying a small Earth globe, bright flowers including sunflowers and daisies, a white dove, a butterfly, and a small golden sun face; the large black five-pointed star from reference image 8 is mounted high on the chapel facade with five smaller black star shapes aligned along the fence rail below; daylight location photography, realistic and physically plausible, crisp depth and clean detail, no collage look; balanced wide composition with clear hierarchy on the singer and chapel, supporting figures and objects distributed left and right, golden hour sun with long clean shadows and bright exposure, subtle controlled pink-purple accent only in nearby props and textiles, saturated but natural colours; palette of sun-bleached white, warm sand, pink-orange, black, green, and sky blue, mood surprising, open, sunlit, and grounded Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one adult person standing and singing into a microphone; reference image 3 shows three adult men seated with guitars in a church-like hall; reference image 5 shows five young men standing among goats. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
